item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.2
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.0.0-beta.2

Build 51

  • Style in the Editor: grain, bloom, halation, glow, and motion blur. Leave more than one on.
  • Film colours: Vintage, black and white, HDR, Retrolux, Drama, Noir, and Grunge.
  • Blend a second photo as a double exposure.
